config.purpose: 16-player primary: civilian cover, independent role-conditioned nomination mixing, public-ballot reasoning with jointly expanded mafia counterstrategies

config.interpretation: Prospectively frozen exploratory protocol. Local behavioral randomization, no team-secret correlation index. intervals: Pointwise Wilson and paired normal/Hoeffding; additional familywise 95% Hoeffding for prespecified test contrasts only.
outcome: good faction terminal win, 0/1; no rollout truncation
